name: Vanguard Archers
headerMeta: Silver era · Ranged Infantry · special · 150 leadership · T3M
pitch: A standard archer unit rated tier-C in the current meta. As of Amya's 2026-06-16 edit (pre-patch), ranged infantry lack the early-game tempo to compete — focus damage is chip or healed, leaving frontline and cavalry to carry games.

doctrines.name: Bowmanship Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: Arrow Rain deals 75% of the unit's base piercing DMG per hit, +150 piercing DMG.

doctrines.name: Precision Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: +120 piercing DMG, +80 piercing AP, +9% rate of fire.

doctrines.name: Whistling Arrow Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: Every 3 hits inflicts bleeding for 12% of target's current HP; can trigger in concert with allied units at weak points.

doctrines.name: Artemis
doctrines.effect: Unlocks Double Strings: fires 2 arrows per shot for 12s, 40s CD; can't combine with other actives except Overwatch.

veterancy.label: Damage line
veterancy.body: Standard for ranged units — DPS focus; all four units in the shared guide follow this.

matchups.siblings: Covered in the same combined guide as Vassal Longbowmen, Imperial Archers, and Ironcap Archer - identical playstyle argument and doctrine build shared across all four. Tier is the only thing that's called out per unit, and Vanguard Archer sits at T3M.
